strings.scoringRules: Scoring: Champions League +5, league title +3, domestic cup +1. 100 league points and/or 100 league goals share one +1 performance bonus. Top Scorer and/or Top Assist share one +1 awards bonus. Maximum season score: 11.
strings.interimLabel: Current Showdown only. Career history is not yet available.
strings.topBarLockSource: DATA_CONTRACT_V1 §10 (A, G-6); not on main yet

SR1.note: Daniel device, private entry. Daniel values are fictional preview data; Nik's unpublished inputs are sealed and absent.

SR2.note: Nik device, private entry. Nik values are fictional preview data; Daniel's unpublished inputs are sealed and absent.

SR3.note: Daniel has published first; own result is read-only and Nik remains sealed. The same privacy rule applies symmetrically when Nik publishes first.

SR4.note: Both managers have published. Both input records are revealed, Daniel first and Nik second. Shared Season Commit is pending; authoritative canonical scoring is not displayed yet.

SR5.note: Shared season is committed and acknowledged; authoritative scoring is read-only and reconciled from the same fictional results.

SR6.note: Review validation/action error with only bounded fictional values. The exact changed-after-review error is layered onto the entering phase.
SR6.error: Your season result changed after review. Choose Edit My Result and review it again before publishing.

SR7.note: Contract loading state; no result values are presented as facts.

SR8.note: Contract empty state; the read succeeded but no usable Season Results record is shown, and no zero score is invented.

SR9.note: Contract partial/interim coverage state; no private rival values or fake complete result is shown.
SR9.interimLabel: Current Showdown only. Career history is not yet available.

SR10.note: Contract unavailable state; provider read failed and no result values are presented as facts.
